placements.why: The document's content is fundamentally about calibration — establishing the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz and verifying it against June reference plates. No existing strata category covers this organizational domain.
placements.title: Instrument calibration verified against reference standards
placements.theme: Calibration activities establish and confirm instrument measurement fidelity against reference standards across the observing band.

placements.title: Spectrograph calibration established and verified against reference plates
placements.theme: Instrument calibration is set at a target frequency and confirmed against reference plates to hold across the full observing band.
placements.why: src-1 asserts calibration at 88.4 MHz, src-2 verifies against June reference plates across the full band, and src-3 recaps both as key decisions — together they establish a thematic subject about spectrograph calibration and its verification that future envelopes can continue to feed.
